steps.text: Send the US$250 starting deposit through one of the accepted methods.

steps.title: Configure
steps.text: Set your risk settings, choose automatic or manual mode, and keep the demo running while you learn.

pros: Fast setup - minutes to a live dashboard.
Free registration and a demo account.
cons: The demo claim buried in the signup flow.
Performance examples without dates or proof.
Asset list that shifts between pages.
The headline fee claim and the real cost disagree.
redFlags: A score and a community mood wearing the same number.
Support figures that contradict each other.
Template placeholders left unrendered.

faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$250, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.

bottomLine: As a product, SpeedTrade offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
The final score lands at 4.6 - a capable platform held back by its own paperwork. Start small, verify the claims yourself and never trade money you cannot lose.
